subject: [PATCH v3 2/6] btrfs: use an on-stack path in btrfs_del_orphan_item()

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the btrfs_del_orphan_item() function to allocate a path on the stack instead of dynamically, which reduces memory allocation failures that can cause transaction aborts. The change is made because the path is relatively small and only ~112 bytes in size, making it suitable for stack allocation. Additionally, the code is refactored to release the path via a common out label due to multiple exit points after the search.
